title: scripts/pm: 13 stale comments still name the deleted ci-failure.mjs, and the end-to-end battery doesn't pin its token (#29471 T3 follow-up)
body:
domain:skills#2 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jT34CXs5fCn3BDirZw

Filing gate: (b) a follow-up the card names. PR #31752 (#29471 family T3, ruling A 6730023204) deletes `scripts/pm/ci-failure.mjs`. The claim 6730060298 kept prose in other staying files out of its surface. The contract review 6730956764 confirmed that list as complete, and added two nits. ⛔ Not a claim.

## 维护者速读

T3 删掉了没人用的 `ci-failure.mjs`，但另外 5 个文件里还有 13 处注释说它存在、说它会 import 什么。这张卡把这些注释改成真话，并给换了样本的端到端自测补上两条它本该断言的事。

## What

Stale prose naming the deleted tool (line numbers on the PR #31752 head 23639351; re-measure on main once it lands):
- `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` :934, :1029, :20807, :30492, :30540, :30596, :30651, :36754 (comments and one self-test label that call `ci-failure.mjs` an importer of the shared classifier)
- `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` :2203, :2213 (population notes)
- `scripts/import-prerequisite.mjs` :224
- `scripts/check-workflow-step-name-quoting.mjs` :23
- `docs/audits/2026-09-self-test-shape-census.md` :376 (a dated audit row; it may stay as history, or get a one-line note)

Review nits on `scripts/check-self-test-workflow-commands.mjs` (the renamed end-to-end battery, new target `scripts/ci/lane-verdict.mjs`):
- N1: no `ok()` asserts that the target's output carries a mid-line workflow-command token, so `scanOutput(r.output).length === 0` passes vacuously on token-free output.
- N2: the block does not pin that the target is in the collected population.

## Ask

- Rewrite or drop each stale comment so it matches the tree. Change no code. A self-test label is renamed only where it names the tool.
- Add the two assertions N1 and N2 name (the battery floor rises by the measured count).
- Tooling only, `skip-changeset`. Blocked-by: #31752 (land first so the line numbers settle).

Blocked-by: #31752
